title: Amazon S3 to Amazon EventBridge to Amazon SNS
description: Publish events directly from S3 to EventBridge and send notifications to SNS when an object is created.

introBox.headline: How it works
text: This template creates an S3 bucket that publishes events to Amazon EventBridge. When an object is uploaded to the bucket, EventBridge is triggered and a SNS notification is sent.
